title: Must or panic
hints: A Must… function is for values that are known to be valid, typically constants in the program itself. Instead of returning an error, it calls panic.
Parse with strconv.Atoi. If that fails, or the number is outside 1–65535, call panic with an error that explains why.
n, err := strconv.Atoi(s); if err != nil { panic(fmt.Errorf("invalid port %q: %w", s, err)) }; if n < 1 || n > 65535 { panic(fmt.Errorf("port %d out of range", n)) }; return n
